spans.s:
mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
New.
m. (-बः)
Praise, panegyrick, celebration.
E.
नु to praise, &c. affix अच्.

f. (-का)
1 A bride, a woman newly married.
2 A new comment.
E.
नव new, and कारिका agent.

f. (-का)
A young woman, either one recently married or one in whom menstruation has lately commenced.
E.
नव new, काल time, कन् added with the fem. form.

m. plu. (-हाः)
The nine planets, or sun, moon, five planets, and the ascending and descending nodes.
E.
नव for नवन्, and ग्रह a planet.

m. (-त्रः)
A student, a novice.
E.
नव new, and छात्र a disciple.

m. (-तः)
An elephant's painted or variegated housings.
E.
नव new, तन् to spread, affix ड.

f. (-ता)
Novelty.
E.
तल् added to नव; also with त्व, नवत्वं.

f. (-तिः or -ती)
Ninety.
E.
नव nine, and क्तिन् aff.

f. (-का)
A painting brush.
E.
नवति ninety, (hairs,) कन् aff.

ind.
Ninety-fold.
E.
नवति, and धा aff.

ind.
Ninety by ninety.
E.
नवति, and शस् aff.

n. (-लं)
1 The new leaf of a lotus.
2 Any young leaf.
E.
नव new, and दल a leaf.

m. (-तिः)
Mars, the planet or its deified regent.
E.
नव nine, दीधिति a ray.

f. (-र्गा)
The nine forms of DURGĀ.
E.
नव, and दुर्गा the goddess.

f. (-ला)
A litter borne by nine men.
E.
नव, and दोल a litter.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Having nine doors; an epithet applied to the body, which has nine inlets or outlets, as the nostrils, ears, mouth, &c.
E.
नव, and द्वार a door.

ind.
Nine-fold, in nine ways.
E.
नव nine, and धा aff.

mfn. always plu. (-व)
Nine.

f. (-नी)
Fresh butter.

n. (-तं)
Fresh butter.
E.
नव new, and नीत procured (from milk, &c.)

n. (-कं)
Clarified butter.
E.
कन् added to the last.

f. (-नुः)
A quantity of butter as a present to Brahmans.
E.
नवनीत, and धेनु a milch cow.

n. (-वं)
A new shoot or sprout.
E.
नव, and पल्लव a shoot.

f. (-का)
1 A bride, a newly married woman.
2 A girl in whom menstruation has recently begun.
E.
नव new, फल fruit, and ठक् aff.

n. (-धूः)
A bride, a newly married woman.
E.
नव, and बधु a wife.

mfn. (-मः-मी-मं)
Ninth.
f. (-मी)
The ninth day of a lunar half month.
E.
नव nine, and मट् aff.

f. (-का)
Double jasmine: see the next.

f. (-का)
Double jasmine, (J. Zambac.)
E.
नव excellent, praised, and मालिका or मलिका jasmine: see the last.

f. (-ना)
A young woman.
E.
नव new, and यौवन young.

f. (-कं)
A newly dyed garment.
E.
नव, रक्त red, and कन् aff.

n. (-ङ्गं)
Gift to five and acceptance by four persons of the best Kāyastha families.
E.
नव, and रङ्ग colour.

n. (त्नं)
1 Nine precious gems, or a pearl, ruby, topaz, diamond, emerald, lapis lazuli, coral, sapphire, and one called

Gomeda.
2

The nine men of letters at the court of VIKRAMĀDITYA, or DHANVANTARI, KṢAPAṆAKA, AMARASIṂHA, SAṄKU, VETĀLABHAṬṬA, GHAṬAKARPARA, KĀLIDĀSA, VARĀHAMIHIRA, and VARARUCI.
E.
नव, and रत्न a jewel.

n. (-त्रं)
The period of nine days, from the first of the light half of Aśvin to the ninth; part of the time devoted to the worship of DURGĀ.
E.
नव, and रात्र for रात्रि a night.

f. (-का)
A newly married woman.
E.
नव new, वर a blessing, affix कन् added, fem. affix टाप्.

n. (-स्त्रं)
New cloth.
E.
नव new, and वस्त्र cloth.

ind.
Nine by nine.
E.
नव, and शस् aff.

n. (-स्यं)
Grain of the year's harvest.
E.
नव, and शस्य grain.

f. (-ष्टिः)
A sacrifice performed on eating the new rice or grain of the year.
E.
नवशस्य, and इष्टि sacrifice.

m. (-कः)
A name given to any of nine inferior classes, the cowherd, gardener, oilman, weaver, confectioner, water-carrier, potter, blacksmith, and barber.

n. (-द्धं)
The first series of Śrāddhas collectively, or funeral offerings on the first, third, fifth, seventh, ninth, and eleventh days after a person's demise.
E.
नव, and श्राद्ध obsequial rite.

f. (-का)
1 A milch cow.
2 A woman recently delivered.
E.
नक new, and सूत offspring, and कन् affix, fem. form.

m. (-शः)
A ninth, a ninth part.
E.
नव, and अंश share.

n. (-न्नं)
1 New rice or grain.
2 A ceremony observed on first eating the rice, &c. of the last harvest.
E.
नव, and अन्न food.

n. (-रं)
New and unbleached cloth.
E.
नव new, and अम्बर cloth.

m. (-र्च्चिः)
The planet Mars or its deified personification.
E.
नव nine, and अर्च्चिस् light.

m. (-हः)
1 A new day.
2 The first day of the fortnight.
E.
नव new, and अह a day.

n. (-णं)
Renewing, doing or making anew.
E.
नव, करण making, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Renewed, revived, done or made anew.
E.
नव, and कृत made, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
New.
E.
नव new, ख pleonasm, and the semivowel changed.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Renewed, revived.
E.
नव, and भूत become, च्चि augment.

ind.
Not so perhaps, a particle implying doubt.
E.
न not, वै expletive.

f. (-ढा)
A newly married woman, a bride.
E.
नव new, and ऊढा a wife.

n. (-तं)
Fresh butter.
E.
नव new, उद्धृत made.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
New, recent, young, &c.
m. (-व्यः)
Praise, panegyrick.
E.
नव new, and यत् aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1

Navigable.
2

Belonging to a boat.
n. (-व्यं)
Newness, novelty.
E.
नौ a boat or vessel, and यक् affix; or नव new, ष्यञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Ninth.
E.
नवम and ठञ्.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Belonging to a vessel, a boat, &c.
m. (-कः)
1 The helmsman of a vessel, the steersman, the pilot.
2 A sailor.
E.
नौ a boat, affix ठन्.
